sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can consolidate Szent István's story: Géza's turn to Christianity, István's coronation, the Christian kingdom he built, his legacy and sainthood, and the Holy Crown.
I can name the key dates: around 1000/1001 (coronation), 1038 (death), 1083 (canonization).
I can explain why István's reign is considered the founding of the Hungarian state.
I can review this unit's vocabulary and grammar (the past participle as an adjective in historical titles).
